title: How to Order Books and Payment
description: Procedure for ordering books from the Office of the Royal Society and payment methods

blocks.heading: How to Order Books and Payment
blocks.lead: Procedure for ordering books from the Office of the Royal Society and payment methods

breadcrumb.label: How to Order Books and Payment

blocks.heading: How to order
blocks.lead: Buyers must pay for the books and shipping in advance before staff can send the books.

items.title: List the books you want
items.body: Send the list of books you are ordering so staff can calculate the shipping cost.

items.title: Make payment
items.body: Pay for the books and shipping using one of the two methods below.

items.title: Send your order details
items.body: Send your order details and delivery address with proof of payment.

items.title: Receive your books
items.body: Staff send the books to the address you provided.

blocks.heading: Payment methods
blocks.lead: There are two ways to pay.

items.title: Postal money order
items.body: Enclose your order details and delivery address with the money order.

details.label: Payable to
details.value: Secretary of the Department, Office of the Royal Society

items.title: Bank transfer
items.body: Fax the transfer slip with your order details and delivery address to the Book Shop.

details.label: Bank and branch
details.value: Siam Commercial Bank PCL, Bureau of the Royal Household (Sanam Suea Pa) branch

details.label: Account name
details.value: Office of the Royal Society (Book Shop)

items.title: Bookshop
items.body: Ask about available books, shipping costs and ordering.
